functions.name: Render_RunProgressivePaletteTransition
functions.body: Publishes A0 to the transition source scratch at 0x00FF7DF2, derives four 16-word palette-band pointers at 0x00FF7262/66/6A/6E, snapshots 64 words from VDP palette memory into 0x00FF8800, clears the progress word at 0x00FFEFF6, and executes 47 iterations. Each iteration waits for VBlank, writes FRAME_PHASE_COUNTER bit 0 to the VDP control/data sequence, calls Render_ConvergePaletteWordsByProgress, increments the progress word and FRAME_PHASE_COUNTER, and returns after the DBF loop.
functions.effect: A VBlank-paced palette transition driver with an exact 47-iteration contract; its surrounding presentation meaning is not assigned here.

functions.name: Render_ConvergePaletteWordsByProgress
functions.body: Loads the progress index from 0x00FFEFF6, selects the current palette at 0x00FF8800 and the VDP palette destination at 0xC000, then processes index+1 words. For each word it compares the source components against the current value in masks 0x000E, 0x00E0, and 0x0E00, adjusts differing components by one two-unit step toward the source, and writes the resulting word through VDP_DATA.
functions.effect: Mutates the current palette snapshot and VDP palette contents; the helper is called by Render_RunProgressivePaletteTransition at 0x001B26F0.

functions.name: Render_ConvergePaletteBandFromBlack
functions.body: Publishes A0 to 0x00FF8880, clears all 16 words at 0x00FF8800, then repeats 16 times: waits for VBlank three times, reloads the source and current palette pointers, selects VDP palette address 0xC020, and for each of 16 words adds one positive two-unit component step toward the source for masks 0x000E, 0x00E0, and 0x0E00 before writing the word to VDP_DATA.
functions.effect: Converges one 16-word palette band from black at VDP palette address 0xC020; no direct caller was recovered in the current static export.

limitations: The entries at 0x001B25AC, 0x001B25DA, 0x001B2618, and 0x001B28DC are alternate entries into already-owned common tails and are intentionally not promoted as standalone ranges.
The higher-level scene or presentation identity of the 47-frame driver and the from-black band helper remains unresolved without a direct caller or runtime capture.
conclusion: Three complete, non-overlapping palette service bodies are now named and range-bounded. Their exact VDP destinations, iteration counts, component masks, and persistent scratch state are recorded without duplicating the overlapping alternate-entry tails.
